$comment: Owned by @golemui/gui-schemas (libs/gui/schemas/src/lib/). Handwritten, edit directly. Shared date and time range definitions used by the gui component schemas.
title: GolemUI Range Definitions

dateRange.description: A single date range used by calendar/date-picker widgets to mark days as disabled.

start.description: ISO-8601 date string for the start of the disabled range (inclusive)

end.description: ISO-8601 date string for the end of the disabled range (inclusive). Omit to disable a single day.

dateTimeRange.description: A single date-time range (two ISO date-times) used by range date-time widgets for disabled instant spans.

start.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for the start of the range (inclusive)

end.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for the end of the range (inclusive). Omit to disable the single instant at start.

isoTime.description: A time of day as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS on a 24-hour clock

timeRange.description: A single time-of-day range used by time-picker widgets to mark times as disabled.

scopedTimeRange.description: A time-of-day range that optionally applies only on one date or on given weekdays. Used by date-time widgets to mark times as disabled.

date.description: ISO date: the range only applies on that date
